svg.title: vLLM KV cache groups: from a layer to a token slot
svg.desc: All groups take block IDs from one BlockPool. The group 1 cell for tokens 4 and 5 is block ID 5, owned by group 1.
svg.text: 2 · Block table cell → block ID in the one BlockPool
all groups take block IDs from one pool · one block ID belongs to one group at a time
sliding window groups free blocks behind the window → null entries, IDs return to the pool
